lines.say: Yohmee Yohmee no Mee. The Revive-Revive Fruit. A power that does nothing at all... until you die.
lines.show: Yomi Yomi no Mi. The Revive-Revive Fruit. A power that does nothing at all... until you die.

lines.say: It's a Paramecia fruit. In life, it gives you no powers. But when you die, your soul comes back. Once.
lines.show: It's a Paramecia fruit. In life, it gives you no powers. But when you die, your soul comes back. Once.

lines.say: The man who ate it was Brook, the musician of the Rum-bar Pirates.
lines.show: The man who ate it was Brook, the musician of the Rumbar Pirates.

lines.say: At Reverse Mountain, his crew left a young whale named Lah-boon behind, promising to come back.
lines.show: At Reverse Mountain, his crew left a young whale named Laboon behind, promising to come back.

lines.say: They never made it. Brook died at sea, and the fruit sent his soul back to find his body.
lines.show: They never made it. Brook died at sea, and the fruit sent his soul back to find his body.

lines.say: But this was the Florian Triangle, a sea buried in thick fog. His soul got lost.
lines.show: But this was the Florian Triangle, a sea buried in thick fog. His soul got lost.

lines.say: When he finally found his body, it was nothing but bones. Only his afro survived. Strong roots!
lines.show: When he finally found his body, it was nothing but bones. Only his afro survived. Strong roots!

lines.say: Then came fifty years alone, drifting on a ghost ship.
lines.show: Then came fifty years alone, drifting on a ghost ship.

lines.say: But the fruit had more to give. Now his soul can leave his body and float around on its own.
lines.show: But the fruit had more to give. Now his soul can leave his body and float around on its own.

lines.say: And that soul carries the chill of the underworld. Cold enough to make ice.
lines.show: And that soul carries the chill of the underworld. Cold enough to make ice.

lines.say: Today he's the Soul King, a rock star. Fun fact: Oh-dah's early sketches gave him a cowboy hat instead of an afro.
lines.show: Today he's the Soul King, a rock star. Fun fact: Oda's early sketches gave him a cowboy hat instead of an afro.

lines.say: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
lines.show: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
